svg.title: Four posteriors from the first seven weeks
svg.desc: Four panels showing the posterior for the screening case, the seed lot, the help desk and the commute, each with its central summary marked.
svg.text: Four cases, four families, one kind of object
Each panel is a distribution over an unknown, not a single estimate.
Case A: probability of the condition
Case D: mean trip time mu
Shaded band: the central 95 percent credible interval. Case A is counted rather than integrated, which is why it is drawn as bars.
